correctness.rationale: Each determinant-one residue fibre is a p^3-point affine hyperplane. Its character sum yields the exact stationary lines; primitive frequencies are supported precisely at two square-determinant points and the two p²-th root phases cannot cancel for odd p. Imprimitive nonvanishing follows from rank-stratified finite-field SL2 sums and cyclotomic divisibility of p-1 roots. Exact cyclotomic enumeration verifies every frequency at p=3 and 400 fixed-seed frequencies at p=5; analytic proof covers all odd primes.
